progression.narrative: The performance opens on Ab3 and dwells most on Ab in Phrase 1. Phrase 6 (0:55.1) introduces As, B, centred on Ab. Phrase 7 (1:04.8) introduces Db, centred on Db. Phrase 9 (1:19.2) introduces B, centred on As. The line peaks at Db5 (543.5 Hz) at 1:08.1. It closes on As4, not the tonic (B4 → As4 → B4 → Ab4 → Db5 → As4).
